description: Plans a devtools company's own YouTube channel as a VOD-first program: whether to run one versus creators or docs-embedded video, pillars tied to a funnel job, ownership and presenter backup, a cadence, Shorts versus long-form, creator sponsorships, and metrics that survive view-count changes. Use whenever someone asks how to start, grow or revive a company developer YouTube channel, what to post, how often to upload, whether to do Shorts, how to work with developer YouTubers, or why views never become signups - even if they only say 'we should be on YouTube'. Not a personal channel or docs video hosting. Not one video's script or description - use samber/developer-relations-skills@technical-video-script; not live streams - use samber/developer-relations-skills@devrel-live-streaming.
